name: sqlite-graph-memory
description: Recall over your markdown notes as a local stdio MCP server: vector search finds entry points, your [[wikilinks]] are the graph, a cross-encoder reranks. No graph database, no server to run; telemetry in one SQLite file. Needs uv. Build the index once with `sgm-index /path/to/notes`.

index_dir.title: Index directory
index_dir.description: Folder holding the index built by `sgm-index /path/to/notes` (it sets BRAIN_INDEX_DIR).
